notes.title: Patch notes, Build 17
notes.notes:
Greetings!

This update was released on March 15, and here are the things that changed. And there's a lot!

[list]
[*] Multiple languages - English, German, Finnish and Swedish word lists are now supported.
[*] Graphical overhaul - Voxel models and animations are in!
[*] New tutorial - Helps you get the hang of things
[*] "Hard mode" campaign - Challenge yourself with10 levels that are even harder, including 4 new gamemodes
[*] Modding support - you can make new campaigns in a text editor
[*] Info overlay - you won't have to guess what the tiles upgrade to anymore!
[/list]

Here's the new campaign and language selection screen:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659256/214d711522efb55790e836b4ad202e11990ec979.png[/img]

Happy Enwordening!

notes.title: Enworden development update & Beta available
notes.notes:
Hello, Enworden developer here. For the last few weeks, I've been working on a major update to Enworden. 

Here's what I've done so far. These changes are available in the beta branch.
[list]
[*] 6 new levels.
[*] An information overlay, you can now see when conduits activate and what the tiles upgrade to.
[*] Support for multiple wordlists.
[*] Deutsch / German wordlist.
[*] New voxel-based graphics. You can switch between the new and old graphics in the options menu.
[*] 4 new gamemodes, more on them below.
[/list]

New voxel-based graphics:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42659256/d2c48db378b04871534fc4783a27de06b08febe0.png[/img]

The overlay looks like this. Click on a tile and it shows its next upgrades:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42659256/4e05be26c53b50871160b26c2c04b00b56de644a.png[/img]

Here's a list of the new gamemodes.
[list]
[*] Triple hunt: Find triplets of letters, much like double hunt but one more.
[*] High stakes: Level multiple tiles all the way.
[*] Palindrome: Only palindromes count. You only have to provide the first half of the palindrome. 3x the points for a full one.
[*] Hyperlexicon: Each letter gets points from the length of the word it appears in. It's like a more developed version of Abecedary.
[/list]

What's left to do:
[list]
[*] 14 more levels to bring the total of new levels up to 20
[*] Score attack, where you just try to make as many words as you can. It would exist as an alternative to the campaigns.
[*] More music. I want to add 6 more pieces, 1 is done so far.
[*] New achievements. I have around 5 new ones planned.
[/list]

If you have any comments, suggestions or wishes, please leave them down below!

notes.title: Patch notes, Build 15
notes.notes:
Build 15 is here! Changes:

[list]
[*]Fix for a bug with canceling tile selections
[*]Added a new "Game over" screen
[*]The middle mouse button now cancels your entire selection
[*]Other small cosmetic fixes
[/list]

As always, to make sure you have the latest version, check that the main screen says "Build 15" in the lower right corner.

notes.title: Patch notes, Build 14
notes.notes:
There is a whole host of changes in Build 14!

[list]
[*]"Retry" and "Next level" buttons in the "Game over" screen
[*]You can now drag your cursor over tiles to select them
[*]Made help more useful
[*]An option to mute the sound when the game goes out of focus
[*]Other small cosmetic fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes, Build 13
notes.notes:
Enworden should now work under Windows 7. This is the only change.

To ensure that you have the latest version, check the lower right corner in the main menu and verify that it says "Build 13".

notes.title: Patch notes, Build 12
notes.notes:
Build 12 is here! I have made the following updates to improve the overall gameplay experience:

[list]
[*]Resolved minor visual issues.
[*]Updated the help menu to clearly indicate that a minimum of two tiles must be chosen.
[/list]

To ensure that you have the latest version, check the lower right corner in the main menu and verify that it says "Build 12". Thank you for your continued support and I hope you enjoy these updates.
